judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 23, which imposed sanctions on people from other countries who help the International Criminal Court investigate, arrest, or prosecute Americans or citizens of allied countries that have not accepted the court's authority. The House passed it 243-140.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 23, which imposed sanctions on people from other countries who help the International Criminal Court investigate, arrest, or prosecute Americans or citizens of allied countries that have not accepted the court's authority. The House passed it 243-140.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 30, which barred immigrants from entering or allowed their removal for stalking, child abuse, child neglect, sex offenses, domestic violence, or violating a protection order. The House passed it 274-145.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 30, which barred immigrants from entering or allowed their removal for stalking, child abuse, child neglect, sex offenses, domestic violence, or violating a protection order. The House passed it 274-145.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 471, which marked high-risk wildfire areas for federal work while exempting many forest management projects from environmental review, narrowing checks for harm to endangered species, and limiting court challenges to those projects. The House passed it 279-141.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 471, which marked high-risk wildfire areas for federal work while exempting many forest management projects from environmental review, narrowing checks for harm to endangered species, and limiting court challenges to those projects. The House passed it 279-141.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 26, the Protecting American Energy Production Act, which barred the President from declaring a halt to fracking without Congress's approval and backed state authority over fracking regulation. The House passed it 226-188.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 26, the Protecting American Energy Production Act, which barred the President from declaring a halt to fracking without Congress's approval and backed state authority over fracking regulation. The House passed it 226-188.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 35, the Agent Raul Gonzalez Officer Safety Act, which set required prison terms for fleeing Border Patrol by vehicle within 100 miles of the border and made immigrants convicted of it subject to removal and barred from asylum. The House passed it 264-155.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 35, the Agent Raul Gonzalez Officer Safety Act, which set required prison terms for fleeing Border Patrol by vehicle within 100 miles of the border and made immigrants convicted of it subject to removal and barred from asylum. The House passed it 264-155.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 11 to cancel the federal ocean-energy agency rule requiring companies to file a report on possible historic sites with offshore oil and gas exploration and development plans. The Senate passed it 54-44.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S.J.Res. 11 to cancel the federal ocean-energy agency rule requiring companies to file a report on possible historic sites with offshore oil and gas exploration and development plans. The Senate passed it 54-44.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.J.Res. 35 to cancel the federal environmental agency rule implementing the waste emissions charge on methane released by oil and gas facilities. The House passed it 220-206.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.J.Res. 35 to cancel the federal environmental agency rule implementing the waste emissions charge on methane released by oil and gas facilities. The House passed it 220-206.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 10, which would end the energy emergency declared under Executive Order 14156 on January 20, 2025. The Senate rejected it 47-52, so it did not become law.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S.J.Res. 10, which would end the energy emergency declared under Executive Order 14156 on January 20, 2025. The Senate rejected it 47-52, so it did not become law.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.J.Res. 20 to cancel the Department of Energy efficiency standards for consumer gas-fired instantaneous water heaters. The House passed it 221-198.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.J.Res. 20 to cancel the Department of Energy efficiency standards for consumer gas-fired instantaneous water heaters. The House passed it 221-198.
